remoteEmptyState.whyStubbed: Live YouTube search returns fuzzy matches for any text (probes recorded in README), and /api/search returns 503 for an all-empty provider chain — a 200 with tracks:[] is unreachable against the real provider, so the zero-track response for this step was supplied via CDP Fetch.respondWithResponse.
